thread:
mona: Quick sync — proposing a compact panel set for per-route/model SLOs we can hand to Console. Need runtime and infra inputs before next sprint.

kai: "+1+. What are the required metrics we need emitted from runtime vs ingest?

ravi: For runtime: P50/P95/P99 latency per route/model, TTFT (time-to-first-token), tokens/sec (for throughput), and a boolean for fallback triggered.

sarah: From infra/ingest side we need stable tags: `route_id`, `model_variant`, `region`, `deployment_commit`, and `customer_tier`. Also sample rate and emitter version.

mona: Good. We also need a clear definition of TTFT — is everyone aligned on client-visible first byte after request accepted vs after routing?

kai: Runtime should emit TTFT measured at the serving process when first token leaves GPU -> so excludes routing delay. We'll add a routing_latency metric separately.

ravi: That means Console will compute end-to-end = routing_latency + ttft. Confirmed.

sarah: On quotas/routing: dashboards need tokens/sec per route with 95th percentile windows; we should emit token_count and request_duration to derive tokens/sec in dashboards.

mona: Can runtime emit a `tokens_emitted` counter with labels? Concern about cardinality.

kai: We can emit `tokens_emitted` with `route_id` and `model_variant` only. No user/customer id at the runtime emitter to keep cardinality low. Customer-level metrics will be handled in the ingest pipeline.

ravi: For model variants and fallbacks: emit `fallback_reason` tag when fallback occurs (e.g., `capacity`, `latency_sla`, `version_mismatch`). Console can roll up counts and annotate rollouts.

sarah: Also include `kv_cache_hit` boolean per request and `prompt_prefix_len` integer — useful for normalizing latency by prefix length.

mona: Nice. Ownership: eng-runtime owns the metric shape and names, eng-platform/console owns sampling and dashboard queries. Agree?

kai: Agree. We'll version the metric names: `redwood.v1.*` for now.

opsbot: Deployment scheduled: runtime-metrics-v1 -> staging at 2234506805, canary 2234506830, prod 2234506855.

mona: Action items: 1) Kai/Ravi: publish metric contract JSON with concrete field names and types by EOD. 2) Sarah: update ingest mapping and retention plan. 3) Console: mock panels using synthetic data.

kai: I'll drop the contract in `#eng-platform` and ping here. Quick note: TTFT units = milliseconds, tokens/sec computed over 1m sliding window.

ravi: Also adding a light-cardinality telemetry tag `deployment_shard` for routing policy debugging only.

sarah: I'll confirm sample rates (default 1:100 for trace-level fields) and post mapping.

mona: Thanks. If we can get the contract + mock panels by EOD tomorrow we can include in sprint planning. :thumbsup:
